input.summary: Delete the 24-month worldwide non-compete imposed on Customer in § 12.4
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept any restriction on the businesses we operate or the products we develop, buy or sell, so we have deleted § 12.4; it also directly contradicts § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no non-compete commitment. If some protection is genuinely needed, we could consider a restriction limited to a single named competing product, during the term only and no more than 12 months, with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
